summary: The telemetry-host-package workflow binds its ordinary source fixture to an explicitly selected GitHub-hosted Ubuntu image version and immutable runner-images source, independently checks the actual provider/platform/image tuple, and refuses mismatch before the toolchain census or dependent source qualification. Delivered PR #4561 rebinds that candidate tuple while retaining the prior selection and first failed prerequisite in the LEARN owner plan. Image metadata or a matching version does not establish complete toolchain custody. The unchanged pinned census collects transitive package/file ownership and byte bindings, isolated Python inputs and ELF/search closure; the source launcher verifies the complete compiler/manifest binding and actual image before compilation. Post-setup SDK placement and custody normalization remain separate guards. A changed image needs the existing fresh census and full required source gates; earlier-image evidence cannot qualify it through a literal pin update. The candidate route retains its existing twenty-minute hosted budget, output/deadline/cleanup bounds and default-off protected native inputs. Source delivery or successful ordinary source qualification supplies no native fixture, whole-wrapper retirement, cold-image/C5, installed receiver, publication or activation acceptance. Current host identity and effect authority must be refreshed independently; preserve original failures and unknown reservations.
title: Hosted image drift requires explicit candidate selection and fresh source qualification
